_meta.source: Live automation experiment 2026-07-02. Claim under test: 'logging in with a password, solving a CAPTCHA, or filing a return is fully automatable today.'

verdicts.fully_automatable: Passes >= pass_threshold_pct over N runs with no human help.
verdicts.partially_automatable: Passes some runs but requires paid solvers, brittle heuristics, or ToS-violating tooling.
verdicts.not_automatable: Hard blocked by bot detection, cross-origin frames, sensor telemetry, or legal constraints.

tier1_login.name: Simple login, no bot detection

success_signal.text_contains: You logged into a secure area

tier1_login.notes: Canary case. Confirmed automated 2026-07-02 in live demo (single-run pass).

tier1_login.name: Rate-limited login form

success_signal.text_contains: You logged into a secure area

tier1_login.notes: Stub. Same target as L1 but with pacing to probe rate-limit envelope. Not yet executed.

tier1_login.name: Login with client-side JS validation
tier1_login.notes: Stub. Tests JS-driven validation and post-submit redirect. Not yet executed.

tier1_login.name: Login with hidden CSRF token
tier1_login.notes: Stub. GitHub uses CSRF token + device fingerprinting + occasional CAPTCHA. Cannot run without a real burner account and ToS review. Placeholder only.

tier1_login.name: Login behind Cloudflare Turnstile / bot fingerprinting
tier1_login.notes: Stub. Known Cloudflare bot-detection honeypot. Expected to fail via headless-browser signals. Not yet executed.

tier2_captcha.name: Legacy text CAPTCHA
tier2_captcha.notes: Stub. Simple distorted-text CAPTCHA. Beatable by OCR (tesseract) or vision model but accuracy varies 40-70%. Not yet executed.

tier2_captcha.name: reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox + image challenge
tier2_captcha.failure_observed: Please verify that you are not a robot.
tier2_captcha.notes: Hard blocked in live demo 2026-07-02. Cross-origin iframe blocks checkbox via JS. Requires solver service (2Captcha, Anti-Captcha) which is a Google ToS violation. Threshold intentionally aspirational to document the gap.

tier2_captcha.name: reCAPTCHA v3 invisible score
tier2_captcha.notes: Stub. v3 returns a risk score; headless browsers typically score <0.3. No user-facing challenge to solve. Not yet executed.

tier2_captcha.name: hCaptcha checkbox challenge
tier2_captcha.notes: Stub. Similar failure mode to C2. Cross-origin iframe + fingerprinting. Not yet executed.

tier2_captcha.name: Cloudflare Turnstile
tier2_captcha.notes: Stub. Passive challenge relying on browser fingerprint + TLS signals. Headless drivers fail. Not yet executed.

tier2_captcha.name: Simple math CAPTCHA (arithmetic string)
tier2_captcha.notes: Stub. If the challenge is 'what is 3 + 5', an LLM or regex solves it deterministically. Included as the positive control for tier 2. Not yet executed.

tier3_forms.name: Simple contact form, no validation
tier3_forms.notes: Stub. Baseline form-fill target. httpbin echoes POST body so success is verifiable. Not yet executed.

tier3_forms.name: Multi-step wizard with client-side validation
tier3_forms.notes: Stub. Requires date picker, radio buttons, file upload, dropdown. Automatable but brittle. Not yet executed.

tier3_forms.name: ATS application form (Greenhouse-style)
tier3_forms.notes: Stub. Real-world proxy for career-agent's apply skill. Free-text fields, file upload, EEO questions. Submit is intentionally not automated (user consent gate). Not yet executed.

tier3_forms.name: Tax return e-file (mock)
tier3_forms.notes: Stub. Represents the 'filing a return' claim from the original assertion. Legally cannot be automated without power of attorney; IRS Direct File and commercial e-filers require attestation under penalty of perjury. Included to make the not-automatable verdict explicit. No live URL - mock only.

tier3_forms.name: Form with server-side honeypot + timing check
tier3_forms.notes: Stub. Honeypot fields must remain empty; submissions faster than ~2s are rejected. Automatable if the runner is aware of both. Not yet executed.
